# Cua Driver

The Windows package connects to the separately installed Cua Driver 0.28.2
from [trycua/cua](https://github.com/trycua/cua). It does not vendor or patch
the native driver source.

[CUA_LICENSE.md](CUA_LICENSE.md) preserves the upstream MIT notice. The notice
applies to Cua's software and does not assign a license to all original code in
this repository. Locally built fixtures, wheels, screenshots, and reports stay
under ignored `windows/artifacts/` or outside the repository.
